title: Brain Lateral House Plate

preferredInputs: public domain or CC BY diagrams
house-style redraw from multiple anatomical references
blockedInputs: photographs unless the pack is explicitly photographic
profile.plateStrategy: clean unlabeled diagram, optionally house-style rendered

requiredArtifacts.source: Original source, open source asset, or data/reference set with license and attribution.
requiredArtifacts.plate: The visible unlabeled image used in the game.
requiredArtifacts.overlay: Dots, polygons, or lines used for clicking. This is separate from the plate.
requiredArtifacts.facts: Short prompts attached to targets. Facts remain blocked until reviewed.
requiredArtifacts.review: Source, target placement, labels, aliases, and facts must be approved before publish.

commands.command: Create or import the unlabeled house-style plate at public/arena/diagrams/brain-lateral-house-plate/plate.svg, then register references in recall/sources/ and recall/source-ledger.json.

notes: The visible plate and the semantic hit zone layer are separate artifacts.
Model output is proposal-only until review approves source, target placement, labels, aliases, and facts.
Publish remains blocked until every approval gate is approved.
